checks.name: Versioned corpus covers the five supported AI languages without empty categories
Actual provider and language-quality claims remain explicitly untested
Missing, duplicate or unsupported corpus languages are rejected before evaluation
Too few math cases, duplicate IDs and absent expected outcomes fail closed
An incorrect expected answer outcome produces a failed report instead of a green summary
A query absent from the authored source fails its declared answerable retrieval expectation
An alleged missing-source query that actually matches is detected
Invalid quotes and unknown adverse-question variants cannot silently pass
Unsupported math is an honest expected unknown, not a verified answer
Repeated evaluation is deterministic apart from timing metadata and preserves the input corpus
Evaluation restores the original fetch function even after an asserted case failure

scope: Regression of evaluator coverage, false expectations, honest unknowns and deterministic execution. These eleven checks are not eleven additional AI answers.
